decisions.reason: The mobile check-in app was featured on the home page and supports the firm's announced innovation-led strategy at airports. Management is likely to blame weak results on the temporary collapse of air travel during COVID-19 rather than on the product, and so persist with it.

The passenger processing product line involved substantial in-house technology investment across several models and is central to the firm's high-end airport positioning. Sunk costs and public commitment favour continuing it as air traffic recovers.

Self-service check-in fits the firm's stated aim of improving efficiency and cutting clients' costs and was prominently promoted. Pandemic-related disappointment can be read as temporary, which supports keeping it.
